body.name: Full-correspondence indexability trichotomy
body.construction: The game lies in \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{all}}\) when \(\varnothing\ne\mathcal D^{\star}\subseteq\mathcal D_1\), in \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{co}}\) when both \(\mathcal D^{\star}\cap\mathcal D_1\) and \(\mathcal D^{\star}\setminus\mathcal D_1\) are nonempty, and in \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{none}}\) when \(\mathcal D^{\star}\cap\mathcal D_1=\varnothing\).
